newsitem.title: THAILAND: Adkinson to issue shares, sell stake to Fuh-Hwa.
newsitem.headline: Adkinson to issue shares, sell stake to Fuh-Hwa.

text.p: Thailand's Adkinson Securities Plc will issue 29 million new shares and sell a stake in the company to Taiwan's Fuh-Hwa Securities Finance Co Ltd, Adkinson said on Monday.

Adkinson will sell 17.8 million shares at 20 baht ($0.65) per share by private placement to Global Asia Capital Ltd, a 100 percent subsidiary of Taiwan's Fuh-Hwa Securities Finance Co Ltd, a company statement said.
Fuh-Hwa is part of Taiwanese conglomerate Ruentex, which interests include textiles and construction.

The proceeds from the sale will be used to cover liabilities and support business expansion through a four billion baht open-ended Kwang Hua Thailand Fund run by another Ruentex subsidiary, Kwang Hua Investment and Trust, Adkinson said. Adkinson is the fund's broker.
The sale is subject to the approval from Thailand's Securities Exchange Commission, the Taiwanese government and Adkinson's shareholders, the statement said.
A further 11.2 million shares will be offered to Sinostar Ltd at 20 baht per share, Adkinson said.
Total funds raised from the share issue are 580 million baht.
Adkinson has set a shareholders meeting for September 17 and registration closes on August 17.

Adkinson shares have climbed sharply from a year low of 9.40 baht per share over the last few months. The shares were up a further 1.25 baht to 29.25 on Monday morning. The composite SET Index was down 5.61 points to 646.43 by 0353 GMT.
